niṭṭha: Niṭṭha (adj.) [Sk. niṣṭha, ni+°tha; cp. niṭṭhā1] ~에 의지하는, ~에 기대는, ~을 의도하는 S III.13 (accanta°); Nd1 263 (rūpa°).
niṭṭhā: Niṭṭhā1 (f.) [Sk. niṣṭhā; ni+ṭhā, abstr. of adj.--suff. °ṭha] 기초, 토대, ~에 익숙함 Sn 864 (expl. SnA 551 by samiddhi, but see Nd1 263).

Niṭṭhā2 (f.) [Vedic niṣṭhā (niḥṣṭhā), nis+ṭhā from °ṭha] 끝, 결론; 완성, 최고, 정상; 목적, 목표 Vin I.255; S II.186; A I.279 (object); Ps I.161. niṭṭhaṁ gacchati 결론을 내다; 비유적으로, 완성에 이르다, 신념에 있어서 완전하다 M I.176; J I.201; Miln 310; freq. in pp. niṭṭhaṁ gata (niṭṭhangata) 완성을 이룬 사람 (=pabbajitānaṁ arahattaṁ patta) DhA IV.70; S III.99 (a°); A II.175; III.450; V.119 sq.; Dh 351; Ps I.81, 161.
niṭṭhāti: Niṭṭhāti [Sk. niṣṭiṣṭhati, nis+tiṭṭhati, the older *sthāti restored in compn] 끝에 있다, 끝내다 J I.220; IV.391; DhA I.393. -- pp. niṭṭhita, Caus. niṭṭhāpeti (q. v.).
niṭṭhāna: Niṭṭhāna (nt.) [abstr. of niṭṭhāti] 끝냄, 수행, 실행, 이행 D I.141; ThA 19 (=avasāya). Cp. san°.
niṭṭhāpita: Niṭṭhāpita ( & Niṭṭhapita) [pp. of niṭṭhāpeti] 성취한, 수행한, 실행한 J I.86, 172 (°ṭha°), 201.
niṭṭhapita: Niṭṭhāpita ( & Niṭṭhapita) [pp. of niṭṭhāpeti] 성취한, 수행한, 실행한 J I.86, 172 (°ṭha°), 201.
niṭṭhāpeti: Niṭṭhāpeti [Caus. to niṭṭhāti] 수행하다, 실행하다; 준비하다, 대비하다, 완성하다 J I.86, 290; VI.366; DhA III.172. -- pp. niṭṭhāpita Cp. pari°.
niṭṭhita: Niṭṭhita (adj.) [Sk. niṣṭhita (niḥṣṭhita), nis+ṭhita, cp. niṭṭhāti] 끝을 내다 또는 끝에 이르다, 끝낸, 완성한; 준비(되게) 하다, 준비된 (즉, 준비가 끝난) Vin I.35; D I.109 (bhattaṁ: 식사가 준비된); II.127 (id.); J I.255 (id.); J II.48; III.537 (끝난); VvA 188; PvA 81; & 책과 책의 장들의 결론에 종종 나타남. aniṭṭhita 완성되지 않은 DhA III.172. -- su° 잘 끝난, 잘 일어난, 완성한 Sn 48, 240. Cp. pari°. Vin I.271; J I.459; also niṭṭhuhaṭi)
niṭṭhubhati: Niṭṭhubhati ( & Nuṭṭhubhiti Vin I. 271; J I. 149; also niṭṭhuhaṭi) [Sk. niṣṭhubhati, but in meaning=Sk. niṣṭhīvati, nis+*thīv, stubh taking the function of ṣṭhīv, since stubh itself is represented by thavati & thometi] 침을 뱉다, 가래를 뱉다 Vin I.271 (nuṭṭhuhitvā); III.132 (id.); J II.105, 117 (nuṭṭh°); VI.367; DhA II.36 (niṭṭhuhitvā). pp. nuṭṭhubhita Sdhp 121. -- Cp. oṭṭhubhati.
niṭṭhubhana: Niṭṭhubhana (nt.) [Sk. niṣṭhīvana, see niṭṭhubhati & cp. Prk. niṭṭhuhana] 침을 뱉음, 침 J I.47; PvA 80 (=kheḷa, v. l. SS niṭṭhuvana, BB niṭhūna).
niṭṭhurin: Niṭṭhurin (adj.) [Sk. niṣṭhura or niṣṭhūra, ni+thūra= thūla; cp. Prk. niṭṭhura] 거친, 딱딱한, 잔인한, 무자비한 Sn 952 (a°; this reading is mentioned as v. l. by Bdhgh at SnA 569, & the reading anuddharī given; vv. ll. SS anuṭṭhurī, BB anuṭṭharī, expld as anissukī. Nd1 440 however has aniṭṭhurī with expln of nitthuriya as under issā at Vbh 357).
niṭṭhuriya: Niṭṭhuriya (nt.) [cp. Sk. niṣṭhuratva] 딱딱함, 모질음, 거침 Nd1 440; Nd2 484 (in exegesis of makkha)= Vbh 357.
